description: HydAPI is the REST interface of the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE) to its archive of historical and active observed hydrological time series in Norway, updated continuously with the latest observations. It offers station metadata, including regulated high and low water levels, mean annual discharge, reservoir capacity, station purpose and minimum discharge requirements, together with series listings, parameters such as water stage (1000), discharge (1001) and air temperature (17), stage-discharge rating curves, daily percentile statistics and observations at instantaneous, hourly or daily resolution in JSON. Data are free under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data, compatible with CC BY 3.0, and each call needs a free API key tied to an email address. The API is version 1.0; metadata for stations and series were extended in February 2023, and a map of stations is available in the Sildre viewer. Caveats: NVE provides the data as is, with possible errors or gaps, throttles requests per key, caps the number of points per request, and may change the API without changing the version number. Simulation uses: inflow and discharge series for reservoir and dam operation models, flood frequency and warning thresholds, drought and low-flow analysis for water supply and irrigation, and hydropower availability for coupled water and electricity models. Related record: Wflow.jl (model-wflow) is a hydrological model that such observed discharge series can calibrate.
